title: TWO FILM STARS WATCHED AS WREXHAM DENIED WOLVES SOLE TOP SPOT
description:
Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney turned up. Wrexham did not lose.

The owners watched the one-all draw with Wolves. Adam Armstrong put Wolves ahead, and Lewis O'Brien equalised, his first goal of the season. Two film stars were watching. The point denied Wolves sole top spot. Wrexham had lost at Sheffield United, beaten Middlesbrough, and now they held Wolves.

Manager Phil Parkinson says the owners' visits lift players, staff and fans. No script needed. And the bigger picture still sounds made up: non-league to the Championship. Any studio would call that script unrealistic.
